question.text: Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA) roles include:

answer.text: Handling investor records and transactions, fund unit administration, and transfer-related processing

explanation.text: The Logic: The PMS pages support the RTA's role in handling investor records, processing transactions, administering fund units and managing transfer-related charges/processing. The Trap: Custody of securities is the custodian's role, separately referenced in the source. Investment advisory is the role of registered investment advisers, not RTAs. Note: Keep the RTA description to record-keeping, transaction processing and transfer administration as supported in the PMS pages, and do not extend it to dividend handling, allotment, or broad company/MF services that the checked pages do not list.
